ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with localized high-intensity (white/cream) distal regions; approximate macro-ratio of 80% low-intensity to 20% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity patches located at the distal tips of both lobes. Right lobe displays a larger white geometric blob extending approximately 40% along the trailing edge. Left lobe displays a thinner white band along 30% of the trailing edge. The central region is a solid black field with sparse, high-contrast white mottling.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular focal spot situated within the high-intensity white patch of the outer-left lobe tip.
